service.method: SELECT DOC_SEQ ,TYPE ,DES_FILE_NAME ,SRC_FILE_NAME ,FILE_SIZE FROM SFILE WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NO = ${attach_key} AND DOC_SEQ = $S{attach_seq} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ)
SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ)),0) MAX_SEQ FROM SFILE WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NO = ${attach_key}
